meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: Claude 会用配好的真实手机号，通过 dial 命令行发短信、发起 AI 语音通话、接收来信和验证码。遇到没用过的命令，它会先看 --help 或官方文档确认用法，再执行并用 --json 取结构化结果。
howto.when: 当你提到短信、电话、验证码等关键词，或想让某人收到消息或来电时触发；同一会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也会先加载。

say.text: 用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信：会议改到三点
say.note: 执行 dial message 发出短信

say.text: 用 dial 打给 +14155550123，问对方收到货没有
用 dial 等一条短信，收到验证码就告诉我

howto.what_en: Claude uses the dial CLI with a pre-provisioned real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts and codes. For unused commands it checks --help or the online docs first, then runs them with --json output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention SMS, calls, or verification codes, or ask to text or ring someone; it also loads before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Use dial to text +14155550123 saying the meeting moved to 3pm
say_en.note: Sends an SMS via dial message

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 with dial and ask if they got the package
say_en.note: Places an AI voice call; check it with dial call get

say_en.text: Wait for an inbound SMS with dial and read me the code
